gappers.catalyst: Kulicke & Soffa (semi capital equipment) extending a fundamentals-driven rally on an AI/memory-demand earnings beat and raised guidance.
gappers.catalyst_detail: KLIC's fiscal Q2 2026 (ended Apr 4) non-GAAP EPS of $0.79 beat the $0.67 consensus by ~18%, on revenue up 49.8% YoY to $242.6M - a swing from a prior-year loss, driven by general semi/memory/automotive/industrial demand. Guidance for fiscal Q3 2026 called for ~$310M revenue and ~$1.00 non-GAAP EPS, with the memory segment up 93% sequentially on NAND/data-center demand. Management raised FY26 capex from ~$12M to ~$22M to expand Thermo-Compression Bonding (TCB) capacity, targeting up to $400M in annual TCB sales. Q3 FY26 earnings are due Aug 5 after close.
gappers.why: Earnings beat plus raised guidance and a structural capex build-out for AI-driven advanced-packaging demand (TCB for HBM/AI chip assembly) is pulling in momentum and fundamental buyers alike - a genuine mechanism, not a headline spike.
gappers.impact: Move looks sustainable relative to a real, multi-quarter fundamental improvement (30-day return +24.8%, 1-year return +263%) rather than a one-day spike, though the stock has already re-rated a long way (P/E 80x trailing, 19x forward) and sits ahead of its own Aug 5 earnings print, which is a binary risk. Sector read-through: bullish for AI/advanced-packaging-exposed semi-equipment peers (e.g. AMKR, also on the watchlist).
